question: 食品生鲜最受哪个区域用户喜欢
gold_sql: select r.region_name from order_items oi join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id join orders o on o.order_id = oi.order_id join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id where c.category_name = '食品生鲜' AND o.status = '已完成' group by r.region_name order by sum(oi.quantity) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE c.category_name = '食品生鲜'
  AND o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1;
